title: 有馬記念の後に・憧れの先へ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki takes first place in the Arima Kinen, and the stands ring with resonant cheers and applause!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's overcome with emotion but has managed to show her audience a beautiful dream. She bows respectfully to them and promises that her miracle will go on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She has fulfilled her goal of becoming the greatest entertainer ever. She's found real confidence and the path she's meant to take.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The curtains close on Fuji Kiseki's show, but the end is merely another beginning. The start of her next show will come sooner than we know…
